definitions.explanation: Something that requires very little effort or is physically comfortable. A casual, childish-sounding variant of 楽 (easy/comfortable). Has an endearing, lighthearted tone.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{楽|らく}ちんだ。
⟦{電子|でんし}レンジ→電子レンジ：04973_denshirenji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}れる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{楽|らく}ちんだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: You can make it in the microwave, so it's easy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在宅|ざいたく}{勤務|きんむ}→在宅勤務：06158_zaitakukinmu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦しなくて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{楽|らく}ちんだ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{運動|うんどう}{不足|ぶそく}→運動不足：08567_undoubusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧がちだ。
examples.english: Working from home is easy because you don't have to commute, but you tend to lack exercise.

notes:
USAGE:
An informal, friendly variant of ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧. The ちん suffix gives it a cute, playful tone. Commonly used in casual conversation, product descriptions (especially for comfortable clothing and shoes), and advertising. Not appropriate for formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽|らく}ちんな⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: comfortable clothes
- {楽|らく}ちんな⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧: comfortable shoes
- {楽|らく}ちん⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧: easy recipe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧: easy, comfortable (standard, all registers)
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧: simple, easy (focuses on simplicity rather than comfort)
